turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: I feel tired after work. My periods seem normal for me.

turns.speaker: Dr Elara Vale
turns.text: Your ferritin is 11 and your hemoglobin is 124. This supports low iron stores without anemia.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: Should I take iron every day?

turns.speaker: Dr Elara Vale
turns.text: For this course take the 300 mg ferrous sulfate tablet every other day. It contains 60 mg elemental iron. Tell me if nausea or constipation makes it hard to continue.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: I will record the dose and bring up any side effects.
